contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]. Die axis is uncertain, weight is 2.2g, diameter is 16mm
